About

Where technique
meets instinct.

The Story

Amanda Jean Prestipino is a DMV-based luxury makeup artist with 8 years of professional experience and formal training from Makeup Designory (MUD) in Los Angeles.

Her foundation is technical, rooted in skin theory, face structure, color balance, longevity, and lighting. She brings the precision of a trained professional and the instinct of an artist who has spent thousands of hours in the chair.

“I don’t do cookie-cutter. I do you, elevated, effortless, and exactly right.”

Amanda’s style has a name: Hollywood Standard Artistry. Not too natural. Not too glam. Every client leaves as the best version of themselves.

She serves brides and clients throughout the DMV, Baltimore, Eastern Shore, and Southern Coastal Delaware, and is available for destination weddings nationwide.

Services & Pricing

Investment in
how you feel.

Bridal
Bridal Trial
$350
2.5 – 3 hours

Two and a half to three hours of collaboration, no templates, no rushing. Work through your vision, test textures and finishes, and leave with a personalized lookbook and complete confidence for your wedding day.

  • Full skin prep and application
  • Luxury product testing for your skin type
  • Lash application and photography lighting checks
  • Personalized lookbook, products, techniques, notes
  • Scheduled 4–8 weeks before your wedding date
Bridal
Wedding Day
$200
On-location · Bride only

Amanda arrives on-location to recreate your trial look, flawlessly and on time. Minimum booking is bride + 3 people ($650 total).

  • On-location service at your getting-ready venue
  • Travel within 30 miles of Dunkirk, MD ($1/mile beyond)
  • Touch-up kit provided
  • Early start fee (before 8am): $75 · Holiday surcharge: 10%
  • Second artist available for larger parties: from $150
Bridal Party
Bridesmaids & Guests
$150
Per person

Full skin prep, false lashes, and a cohesive finish that photographs beautifully.

  • Bridesmaids, mothers of bride/groom, guests: $150 each
  • Junior bridesmaids (ages 12–16): $75
  • Flower girls (under 12): complimentary
